dict.string: wizards.bot talks to your home when it runs on a computer in your network.
The camera reads the code that connects this device to your home and the code of an invite, and takes the photos you send to your agents. A photo goes to your home only when you send it.
The microphone hears what you say to your agent instead of typing. It is turned into text on this device, and only the text is sent.
What you say is turned into text on this device, never by a service elsewhere. The text goes to your agent like a message you typed.
Your agents ask this phone about your calendar. It is read here, and only the answer goes to your home. A new or changed entry asks you first.
Your agents ask this phone about your reminders. They are read here, and only the answer goes to your home. A new or changed reminder asks you first.
Your agents ask this phone about your contacts. They are read here, and only the answer goes to your home.
